scenes.name: Throbbing Gristle
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: Nacidos del grupo de performance COUM Transmissions (Fluxus, accionistas vieneses, sexo y fluidos corporales en galerías), Genesis P-Orridge, Cosey Fanni Tutti, Peter «Sleazy» Christopherson y Chris Carter giran hacia la cultura pop para desafiar a un público más amplio. El escándalo de Prostitution en el ICA (1976) los convierte en enemigos públicos. «Antimúsica»: sin batería, instrumentos tocados como un niño, el «Gristle-izer» (un sampler primitivo), infrasonidos, improvisación en directo y una «línea de montaje sonora». Su sello Industrial Records y el lema «Music from the Death Factory» bautizan un género. The Second Annual Report, el electro pop torcido de «United» y «Hot on the Heels of Love», D.o.A., 20 Jazz Funk Greats y Heathen Earth; coqueteos con la imaginería nazi, la pedofilia y el supervivencialismo militar de Monte Cazazza («Subhuman», «Discipline»). La «misión terminó» en 1981; P-Orridge funda Psychic TV.

podcast.title: Pandrogyny Project – Matching Breast Implants on Valentine's Day 2005 with Life Partner Lady Jaye
podcast.body: Genesis P-Orridge, founder of Throbbing Gristle (who coined the term "industrial music" with their 1977 debut *The Second Annual Report*) and later Psychic TV, entered into a relationship with Psychic TV keyboardist Lady Jaye Breyer that was itself conceived as an ongoing performance art piece. The goal was to make the two people look increasingly alike through shared wardrobes, matching haircuts, permanent eyeliner, lip injections, oral surgeries, cheek implants, and ultimately matching breast implants, received together on Valentine's Day 2005. Their shared identity was to be called Ms. Breyer P-Orridge — a merged being making a statement about the oneness of humanity and the obsolescence of traditional gender roles. Genesis retained his original genitalia; Lady Jaye declined to have anything added. Lady Jaye died on October 9, 2007, from a previously undiagnosed heart condition possibly connected to her long-term battle with stomach cancer. "Their goal was to merge their identities into a single being."
